datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Guatemala in 2013, classifying geographic units into food insecurity phases based on standardized assessment protocols. The data represents medium-term projections of acute food insecurity conditions across different scenarios.
